segments.text: Welcome back! In the last video we talked about materials and the physical laser.
segments.zh: 欢迎回来！上一个视频我们讲了材料和激光切割机硬件本身。

segments.text: Today we're going to be talking about the software side of things.
segments.zh: 今天我们要讲软件方面的内容。

segments.text: In this video we're going to be talking about X-Tool Studio, sometimes listed as X-Tool Creative Studio.
segments.zh: 在这个视频里，我们要讲 xTool Studio，有时也写作 xTool Creative Studio。

segments.text: This is the software where you will create all of your laser designs.
segments.zh: 这是你用来制作所有激光设计的软件。

segments.text: You are welcome to come use it at the library, but you can also download and use it from home.
segments.zh: 欢迎你来图书馆使用它，你也可以在家下载使用。

segments.text: This can be particularly useful if you'd like to do some advanced design work before you come in to start running your projects.
segments.zh: 如果你想在来馆运行项目之前先做一些进阶的设计工作，这会特别有用。

segments.text: If you do download it at home, you will be prompted to create an X-Tool account.
segments.zh: 如果你在家下载，它会提示你创建一个 xTool 账户。

segments.text: The software is still free, but it will have you create a login.
segments.zh: 软件仍然是免费的，但需要你创建一个登录账户。

segments.text: When you are at the library, we will have you be logged into and use the library account.
segments.zh: 在图书馆时，我们会让你登录并使用图书馆的账户。

segments.text: So please do not log into a personal account on the library computer.
segments.zh: 所以请不要在图书馆电脑上登录个人账户。

segments.text: When you are on the library computer, you should see this as your home page.
segments.zh: 在图书馆电脑上，你应该会看到这个主页。

segments.text: You will at the top see recently opened files. These will be files from either you or other laser users.
segments.zh: 顶部是最近打开的文件，这些可能是你的文件，也可能是其他激光用户的文件。

segments.text: We do ask that you be respectful. Please don't open and begin editing other users designs.
segments.zh: 我们希望你尊重他人，请不要打开并编辑其他用户的设计。

segments.text: Down below that you can also see suggested designs from X-Tool.
segments.zh: 下面还能看到 xTool 推荐的设计。

segments.text: These are going to be designs from other laser users outside of the library, but you are welcome to open and use these.
segments.zh: 这些是图书馆以外的其他激光用户的设计，但欢迎你打开使用。

segments.text: They are intended to be shared and made.
segments.zh: 它们本来就是供大家分享和制作的。

segments.text: Over here on the left side is your navigation menu.
segments.zh: 左边这里是导航菜单。

segments.text: There are several things that you can do from here.
segments.zh: 在这里你可以做几件事。

segments.text: The first is go to the MySpace tab.
segments.zh: 第一是进入 MySpace 选项卡。

segments.text: This will be where any designs that are uploaded and saved to the shared library account end up.
segments.zh: 所有上传并保存到图书馆共享账户的设计都会放在这里。

segments.text: If you choose to save your design, it will be visible to other users here.
segments.zh: 如果你选择保存设计，其他用户在这里就能看到它。

segments.text: Once you have finished your design, if you would like it to no longer be visible to other users,
segments.zh: 完成设计后，如果你不想让其他用户再看到它，

segments.text: you can hit the three dots in the corner of your design and hit delete.
segments.zh: 可以点击设计角落的三个点，然后点删除，

segments.text: That will remove it from here.
segments.zh: 这样就会把它从这里移除。

segments.text: The other option right above that is the download button.
segments.zh: 它正上方的另一个选项是下载按钮。

segments.text: That is going to be the easiest way to transfer files.
segments.zh: 这是传输文件最简单的方式。

segments.text: If you have made a design at home that you would like to bring into the library to run,
segments.zh: 如果你在家做了一个设计，想带到图书馆来运行，

segments.text: the easiest way to achieve that is to download it as an XCS file.
segments.zh: 最简单的办法就是把它下载为 XCS 文件。

segments.text: Right here we can see XCS is our file format.
segments.zh: 这里我们可以看到，XCS 就是我们的文件格式。

segments.text: We can save it, in this case to our downloads folder.
segments.zh: 我们可以保存它，这里是保存到下载文件夹。

segments.text: You would choose to save it to a flash drive, upload it to your email, upload it to your Google Drive.
segments.zh: 你可以选择保存到 U 盘，上传到电子邮件，或上传到 Google Drive，

segments.text: However you want to transport that file to the library.
segments.zh: 用任何你想用的方式把文件带到图书馆。

segments.text: What you would then do is either plug your flash drive in to the library computer
segments.zh: 然后你可以把 U 盘插到图书馆电脑上，

segments.text: or log into your email on the library computer to download that file.
segments.zh: 或者在图书馆电脑上登录你的邮箱下载那个文件。

segments.text: Download it and then hit upload up here in the corner.
segments.zh: 下载之后，点击右上角这里的上传。

segments.text: From here you can select which file you are uploading.
segments.zh: 在这里你可以选择要上传哪个文件。

segments.text: When we hit open, we will see that new file up here.
segments.zh: 点击打开后，就会在这里看到那个新文件。

segments.text: In this case, we have a copy of this feather design.
segments.zh: 这里我们有一份这个羽毛设计的副本。

segments.text: Either one of those is going to work just fine.
segments.zh: 两个中的任何一个都完全可以用。

segments.text: I could open both of these and they would be the exact same
segments.zh: 我可以把两个都打开，它们会完全一样，

segments.text: and it will save things like the cut settings and things like that.
segments.zh: 而且它会保存切割参数之类的设置。

segments.text: Since we don't need two copies of that design, I am going to go ahead and delete it.
segments.zh: 既然我们不需要这个设计的两份副本，我就把它删掉。

segments.text: A little further down, we have our explorer tab.
segments.zh: 再往下一点是我们的“探索”选项卡。

segments.text: This is going to be where you can find existing designs.
segments.zh: 你可以在这里找到现有的设计。

segments.text: These are all going to be from other XTool users outside of the library.
segments.zh: 这些都来自图书馆以外的其他 xTool 用户。

segments.text: This is going to be where people come to share designs that they have made.
segments.zh: 大家会到这里来分享自己做的设计。

segments.text: You can either just take the homepage and see what you see
segments.zh: 你可以只看主页，看看有什么，

segments.text: or you can search for specific things.
segments.zh: 也可以搜索特定的东西。

segments.text: In this case, I was searching for coffee themed designs.
segments.zh: 这里我搜索的是咖啡主题的设计。

segments.text: You can also search for things like dinosaurs.
segments.zh: 你也可以搜索恐龙之类的东西。

segments.text: If you are looking for something more practical, you can search for a desk organizer
segments.zh: 如果你想找更实用的东西，可以搜索桌面收纳盒，

segments.text: and find a wide variety of designs.
segments.zh: 就能找到各种各样的设计。

segments.text: Once you have found a design that you like,
segments.zh: 找到喜欢的设计之后，

segments.text: let's come back and search for something basic like a nice cat.
segments.zh: 我们回来搜索一个简单的东西，比如一只漂亮的猫。

segments.text: I think this will work really well.
segments.zh: 我觉得这个会很合适。

segments.text: Let's go ahead and open up these cat earrings.
segments.zh: 我们打开这对猫咪耳环。

segments.text: When we click on that design, we can see a couple of things.
segments.zh: 点击这个设计后，我们能看到几样东西。

segments.text: We can see what material that they used.
segments.zh: 能看到他们用了什么材料，

segments.text: We can see a preview of what the design will look like.
segments.zh: 能看到设计成品的预览，

segments.text: We can see the user that submitted this design.
segments.zh: 能看到提交这个设计的用户，

segments.text: Then we can see which machine that they used.
segments.zh: 还能看到他们用的是哪台机器。

segments.text: In this case, since we have a P2S, we would like to see
segments.zh: 这里，因为我们用的是 P2S，我们希望看到

segments.text: that listed as either the machine that they used
segments.zh: 它被列为他们使用的机器，

segments.text: or here under compatible machines.
segments.zh: 或者在这里的兼容机型下列出。

segments.text: If the P2S is not listed as a compatible machine,
segments.zh: 如果 P2S 没有列为兼容机型，

segments.text: that doesn't mean your design won't work,
segments.zh: 并不意味着你的设计就用不了，

segments.text: but it may mean you have to do a little more converting in terms of size,
segments.zh: 但可能意味着你需要多做一些转换，比如尺寸方面、

segments.text: in terms of getting the file to function,
segments.zh: 让文件能正常运行方面，

segments.text: especially things that are made specifically for UV lasers,
segments.zh: 尤其是专门为紫外激光器制作的设计，

segments.text: like the F2 and F1,
segments.zh: 比如 F2 和 F1，

segments.text: may have some struggles being ported over to a CO2 laser
segments.zh: 移植到 CO2 激光器上可能会有些困难，

segments.text: like the one we use here at the library.
segments.zh: 比如我们图书馆这里用的这台。

segments.text: You can also see the material that they used here.
segments.zh: 你还能在这里看到他们使用的材料。

segments.text: You do not have to use the same material,
segments.zh: 你不必使用同样的材料，

segments.text: but if you would like your design to match theirs,
segments.zh: 但如果你希望你的成品和他们的一样，

segments.text: you'll want to use something that looks similar.
segments.zh: 就要用看起来相似的材料。

segments.text: Then we can go ahead and hit open,
segments.zh: 然后我们可以点击打开，

segments.text: and we can see our design pull up.
segments.zh: 就能看到我们的设计加载出来。

segments.text: When you are on the library account,
segments.zh: 在图书馆账户上，

segments.text: you'll see the laser already connected.
segments.zh: 你会看到激光切割机已经连接好了。

segments.text: In this case, it is not because I'm recording in the studio,
segments.zh: 这里没有连接，是因为我在工作室里录制，

segments.text: but we'll show what it looks like
segments.zh: 不过稍后我们会展示

segments.text: when the laser is connected a little down the line.
segments.zh: 激光切割机连接后是什么样子。

segments.text: But I can see my design.
segments.zh: 但我能看到我的设计。

segments.text: I can select it and move it around if I need to.
segments.zh: 如果需要，我可以选中它并四处移动。

segments.text: I can also move around specific elements,
segments.zh: 我也可以移动特定元素，

segments.text: so I can either move all of my design
segments.zh: 所以我既可以移动整个设计，

segments.text: or just specific parts to reorient them.
segments.zh: 也可以只移动特定部分来调整方向。

segments.text: Now, this is an important distinction.
segments.zh: 现在有一个重要的区别：

segments.text: Not all designs are free.
segments.zh: 并不是所有设计都是免费的。

segments.text: When you are on the library account,
segments.zh: 在图书馆账户上，

segments.text: we will ask you to only utilize free designs,
segments.zh: 我们会要求你只使用免费设计，

segments.text: but there are paid designs here in Extool Studio.
segments.zh: 但 xTool Studio 里也有付费设计。

segments.text: I'm going to turn on our filters
segments.zh: 我先打开筛选器，

segments.text: so that we only see those for just a moment.
segments.zh: 让我们暂时只看付费设计。

segments.text: When you see a file that is like this
segments.zh: 当你看到像这样的文件，

segments.text: and has a price in the corner,
segments.zh: 角落里标有价格，

segments.text: that is one that we will ask you
segments.zh: 这就是我们会要求你

segments.text: to not use while on the library account.
segments.zh: 在图书馆账户上不要使用的。

segments.text: What you can, however, do
segments.zh: 不过你可以做的是，

segments.text: is make this purchase on a personal device,
segments.zh: 在个人设备上购买，

segments.text: so on your own computer, on your own cell phone,
segments.zh: 也就是在你自己的电脑或手机上，

segments.text: log into a personal account,
segments.zh: 登录个人账户，

segments.text: click on one of these designs,
segments.zh: 点击其中一个设计，

segments.text: and once you purchase it,
segments.zh: 购买之后，

segments.text: it will provide you the file as an XCS format.
segments.zh: 它会以 XCS 格式提供文件给你。

segments.text: XCSes are transferable,
segments.zh: XCS 文件是可以传输的，

segments.text: so once you have purchased it on a personal device,
segments.zh: 所以一旦你在个人设备上购买了，

segments.text: you can, just like we talked about before,
segments.zh: 就可以像我们之前讲的那样，

segments.text: place it on a flash drive or email it to yourself
segments.zh: 把它放到 U 盘上或者发邮件给自己，

segments.text: and then open that already paid for file
segments.zh: 然后在图书馆账户上

segments.text: here on the library account.
segments.zh: 打开这个已经付费的文件。

segments.text: In the next video, we'll take a little more
segments.zh: 在下一个视频里，我们会更深入地

segments.text: in-depth look at our earring design here
segments.zh: 看看这个耳环设计

segments.text: and the software side of things.
segments.zh: 以及软件方面的内容。

segments.text: We'll talk about how to edit a design
segments.zh: 我们会讲如何编辑设计，

segments.text: or create a design from scratch
segments.zh: 或者从零开始创建设计，

segments.text: and how to use some of the tools here in the canvas.
segments.zh: 以及如何使用画布中的一些工具。
